description: Recreation of the NES noise generator, with that chip's long and short pseudo-random sequences and no envelope

params.text: Picks one of the sixteen NES noise periods, 0 to 15, the noise growing coarser and lower as the number rises
Chooses between the long pseudo-random sequence and the short repeating ones
Chooses which short sequence runs, 93 bits long or 31 bits long, and does nothing while the long sequence is chosen
Picks which of the 352 distinct 93-bit sequences runs, 0 to 351, and does nothing unless the short 93-bit sequence is chosen

inputs.text: Sets the noise period in place of the knob, 0V to 10V covering all sixteen of them
